description: List the asset slots (image/video placeholders) for a landing page or side page, with each slot's current asset assignment. Use this to discover valid slotKeys before calling assign_asset_to_slot. Pass sidePageSlug to inspect a side page's slots.

pageKey.description: Page key within the LP (defaults to 'main'; ignored when sidePageSlug is set)

sidePageSlug.description: Side page slug — inspect this side page's slots instead of the main LP's

name: list_asset_slots
